map.输入“hello world”，大写→“HELLO WORLD”，小写→“hel: Input "hello world", uppercase → "HELLO WORLD", lowercase → "hello world", Title Case → "Hello World" (only the first letter of each word is capitalised, the rest unchanged). Note that Title Case only replaces the initial letter; upper case already inside a word stays as-is.
map.首字母大写会改动单词内部字母吗？: Will Title Case change letters inside a word?
